description: Connect one of the seven certified exchanges (see setup's exchange list) to your account: creates a webhook and links it to your already-saved credentials for that exchange, the same steps 2-4 the website's setup wizard runs. Safe to call more than once -- if a webhook is already linked, it reports connected:true and creates nothing new. If you have no credentials saved for this exchange yet, returns connect_url instead: open it in a browser to add them (no exchange secret can be pasted into this chat), then call connect again with the same exchange. Connecting a real-money (non-paper) exchange requires a live-scoped token; any token can connect a paper/testnet exchange. Requires your Autoview account token.

hook_id.description: link this specific existing hook instead of letting connect pick or create one (see the `hooks` tool for your hook ids). Must have no other exchange linked -- an order fires on every exchange a hook links, so connect refuses to add a second one; omit hook_id to get a dedicated hook

token.description: your Autoview account token — an av_mcp_ personal access token, generate one at /account/tokens/ on the Autoview site. Omit this if your MCP client already sends it as an `Authorization: Bearer` header (Claude Code, Cursor, and most non-browser clients do this automatically once configured).

name: connect
